chose: A point answered by a take of its own is `tickets[i].points[j].answer`: a take carries its transcript, one `mark` ({mark, note?}, the same shape as a whole take's `marks[i]`) and its own SOLO level; or a silence (a guess, or unheard). No `verdict` field yet: each point object is strict, so RR29's optional `verdict` is an additive field in a later version.
options: `marks` of length one, sharing the whole take's schema
gray: The server reads only `points[j].answer.kind`; how the reading inside is shaped is the essay's. A one-item `marks` would read the same on screen but invite a length check that means nothing.
undo: Rename `mark` to `marks` in PointAnswerSchema and values.ts's PointValuesSchema; essays already written would need a new template version.
